findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_marketplace_jobs, post_job, list_open_jobs, submit_bid · Private data: create_escrow_vault, evaluate_escrow_work, get_escrow_info, list_marketplace_jobs, list_marketplace_skills, direct_hire, post_job, list_open_jobs, award_job, check_wallet_sanctions, get_wallet_verification_challenge, confirm_wallet_ownership · Public sink: audit_task, evaluate_escrow_work, list_marketplace_jobs, post_job, list_open_jobs, submit_bid, get_wallet_verification_challenge, confirm_wallet_ownership.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_marketplace_jobs, post_job, list_open_jobs, submit_bid · Private data: create_escrow_vault, evaluate_escrow_work, get_escrow_info, list_marketplace_jobs, list_marketplace_skills, direct_hire, post_job, list_open_jobs, award_job, check_wallet_sanctions, get_wallet_verification_challenge, confirm_wallet_ownership · Public sink: audit_task, evaluate_escrow_work, list_marketplace_jobs, post_job, list_open_jobs, submit_bid, get_wallet_verification_challenge, confirm_wallet_ownership

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
